tickets.name: Get on the Board
tickets.note: 76ers at Bulls, and the race to the first bucket starts at center court! Smith has to deal with Embiid in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! That hands the 76ers the first possession, and that's half the battle! The Bulls get a stop? Then it's Smith running the other way for the first two! Nobody else here beats his price, so it's Smith or bust!

tickets.name: First Look
tickets.note: Lakers at Pistons, and here's how we see the opening act! The jump ball goes Kessler against Reed, and Kessler has the springs tonight! Win that tip and the Lakers are first in line to score. If Kessler wins the jump, he seals his man, and that's an easy two to start the night! Kessler is the lone value in this one, and we are HERE for it!

tickets.name: Set Play
tickets.note: Here comes Jazz at Timberwolves, and the opening tip is where our night begins! It's Hayes against Gobert in the circle, and neither one has the edge! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Jazz to cash the first trip! First play out of the timeout? Nope, first play of the game, and it's Bailey with the ball! Hayes is lurking on the weak side for the kick-out! One bucket from any of them and we're cashing. Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

tickets.name: Top of the Key
tickets.note: Nets and Mavericks, and the first bucket of this one has our fingerprints all over it! Sharpe and Gafford go up for the tip, and that one's a coin flip, baby! Wide open at the start, and we're riding the Nets! If Sharpe wins that tip, he goes right back to work, and he's the first look! Miss on the first look and Traore is crashing for the putback! The stakes are split so any one of them pays for the whole game. Beautiful!

tickets.name: Early Offense
tickets.note: Lights up for Celtics at Bucks, and we know exactly who we want touching the ball early! Queta squares up with Turner for the opening tip, and we like Queta to control it! Either side can strike first here, and we like the Bucks to make it count! If Turner controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look! Burries is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! Whoever lights it up first, the split covers the game. Let's ride!
